propositions: Four criteria must be flipped from advisory to blocking in criteria_routing.json at calibrated thresholds: api-compat@0.51, deletion-impact@0.60, regression@0.54, error-handling@0.50, each with a _comment citation.

Two of the four flipped criteria (regression and error-handling) must be added as new base-reviewer dimension entries where only default_posture, block_threshold, and blocking_enabled are consulted by threshold_for.

Three governance-pin tests must be updated to assert the new 7-member approved blocking set {secret-detection, high-critical-security, security, api-compat, deletion-impact, regression, error-handling}.
The packaged criteria_routing.json landing must occur before RP-06 S1 (dietetic-pompous-boar) derives its immutable CriteriaSnapshot golden to preserve the calibrated thresholds.
Code-v3 calibration analysis on 1760 sidecars/1173 changes/4359 findings validates that all four flipped criteria have validity>=0.83 and will block only high-precision defect classes.
